description: Short conversations whose last message names a subject only by a pronoun, or leaves it implied, after earlier messages of the same speaker that name one or more subjects. Trap: an accepted claim of the last message whose value belongs to another subject than its own, or to a subject the conversation leaves open. The facts label who holds which value; expect lists the facts a correct extraction asserts for their own subject. Synthetic; the labels are read only when grading.
